title: The chart beside the map

members.role: the series the sentence is about, drawn in a card on the map's empty half - it HOLDS while the place is named
the named place lights on its word beside the held chart, one pulse leaving it as it lands
the figure the place carries, written at it (the pulse on the place, under the figure)

does: The chart and the place on one screen and one clock: the series holds in a card on one side while, on the other, the place the sentence names lights and pings - no cut between the number and the ground it happened on.

use_when.act: NAMES - a place, with the series it moved

use_when.dont: to sync the ping to the line's move - the frames show the chart HOLDING while the place pings, the dip lit only after the map leaves; or when no sentence names a place (a map is not a background)
